title: Reporting Advice with If I Were You — Quiz 136

## Reporting Advice with If I Were You

Use advised and an infinitive when reporting this form of advice.

### Lesson focus

1. My friend said, “If I were you, I would not buy these rotten mangoes.”
2. He said, “If I were you, I wouldn't drink that wine.”

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
